name: Sal Automotive Limited
about: Sal Automotive Limited manufactures and sells automobile components in India. The company operates through two segments: Automobile Components and Agriculture Implements. It offers automobile components, which includes tractor seats, LCV seats, and seat frames and mechanisms for passenger cars and commercial vehicles; and agriculture implements, such as rotavators, tractor trailers, box scrappers, rotary tiller, and planters. The company was formerly known as Swaraj Automotives Limited and changed its name to Sal Automotive Limited in July 2019. Sal Automotive Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Mohali, India. Sal Automotive Limited is a subsidiary of b4s Solutions Pvt. Limited.
